independent_derivation_or_calculation: Independent verification from first principles: 1. Energy conservation: dE_universe = 0 => dE_system + dE_surroundings = 0. Partitioning system energy into macroscopic mechanical energy E_macro and internal microscopic energy U: with dE_macro = 0, dE_system = dU. 2. Inexact boundary transfers: Heat absorbed dQ and work done by system dW = P dV satisfy -dE_surroundings = dQ - dW => dQ = dU + dW. Dimensions: [M L^2 T^-2] (Joules). 3. Mathematical structure: U is an exact differential (state function) so oint dU = 0 for any closed path, and delta U depends solely on endpoints. In contrast, dQ and dW are path-dependent inexact differentials. 4. Ideal gas internal energy: Joule's experiment confirms U = U(T) only, so dU = n C_v dT for any arbitrary process of an ideal gas.

Complete dimensional consistency ([M L^2 T^-2]).
